clips.send: A small business owner sends this to a friend too scared to film one take of their first ad - awe that one unscripted take built a $450 million business.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau shot his very first infomercial in a small meditation community in Fairfield, Iowa, back in 1989.

He went in, spoke for about an hour, and that was it. No retakes, nothing. They just edited together the one take he gave them.

That single infomercial helped Mega Memory go on to sell $450 million worth of home study courses. Kevin Trudeau says the high energy of the place he filmed in had a lot to do with it.

One take, $450 million. Would you have believed it?

#kevintrudeau #megamemory #success #wealthmindset #business #money

clips.send: Someone who just paid for a coaching program sends this to a friend about to do the same - anger at realizing the coach selling success has none of it himself.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau has a warning about most self-help and success coaches out there.

He says look at who's teaching you. If a so-called success coach is living in his mother's basement, 80 pounds overweight, with health problems he can't fix, how is he qualified to coach you on success?

Kevin Trudeau's rule: you can't teach what you don't have. He refused to teach a single seminar until after he had already made millions himself.

Who's actually teaching you, and what have they built?

#kevintrudeau #success #mindset #selfhelp #money #wealthmindset

clips.send: A skeptic sends this to a friend who follows a guru with no track record - the shock that Kevin Trudeau spent $30,000 just to prove his own claims first.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau never taught a single motivational seminar until he had made over $15 million on his own.

Then, before he wrote the book Natural Cures, he spent over $30,000 proving his own health: blood work, an MRI of his brain, CAT scans, a hair analysis, even urine and skin tests. Every test known to man, and he paid for every one himself.

He wanted proof before he ever asked anyone to believe him.

Would you spend that to back up your own claims?

#kevintrudeau #success #money #business #wealthmindset #credibility

clips.send: Someone grinding alone sends this to a friend who thinks hard work by itself is enough - the anxiety that the real rich all share a network they don't.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there is one thing nearly every wealthy, successful person has in common.

They're a member of a private association, secret society, exclusive club or private group. Skull and Bones at Yale. The Harvard Alumni Club. Freemasons. YPO, the Young Presidents Organization. Kevin Trudeau says a lot of billionaires belong to groups like these.

He says being around other like-minded, motivated, successful people creates an effect you can't get grinding alone.

What group are you surrounding yourself with?
